mentions.name: KingD
mentions.description: A Linux-based operating system that unifies the roles of router, NAS, and virtualization platform behind a single user interface, providing one centralized platform that encodes common infrastructure management workflows.
mentions.problem: Managing multiple FreeNAS, OPNsense, and Proxmox installations means repeatedly performing the same workflows across separate platforms.
